First add 20 and 18, then multiply the result by 5. The answer is 190. (20 plus 18) times 5 equals 190.

A classroom in a recycling club has 32 blue counters and 42 red counters in each box. There are 2 boxes. How many counters altogether? The answer is 148. (32 plus 42) times 2 equals 148.
